mapillary-js 4.1.2 (MIT), dist/mapillary.js, with one change.

The filter compiler (class Ht, createFilter) built its test with new Function(...),
which the portal's content-security policy (no unsafe-eval) refuses. createFilter now
returns a closure from _fn() that does the same comparisons (==, !=, >, >=, <, <=, in,
!in, all) without evaluating a string. Nothing else is changed.
